plugin.webfilter.localization.key.name: Web Filter
plugin.webfilter.subtitle: Block sites and applications by category, allowlist and blocklist per profile.
plugin.webfilter.dashboard.title: Web Filter control and events
plugin.webfilter.dashboard.delivery.empt: No device has received or is waiting for a Web Filter policy.
plugin.webfilter.dashboard.events.empty: No recent block has been recorded.
plugin.webfilter.policies.title: Device profiles
plugin.webfilter.categories.hint: They apply to sites and applications. "DNS over HTTPS" is always blocked while the filter is active so it cannot be bypassed.
plugin.webfilter.lists.hint: One item per line. A domain also covers all its subdomains. Decision order: allowlist, blocklist, category.
plugin.webfilter.dns.host.none: set the DNS domain in the Settings tab to filter sites
plugin.webfilter.saved: Saved. Devices of the profile were told to sync.
plugin.webfilter.apps.title: Customer application categorization
plugin.webfilter.apps.hint: Add your own Android packages to a category. Profiles blocking the category block the package.
plugin.webfilter.settings.title: Site filter settings
plugin.webfilter.blockpage.title: Blocked page experience
plugin.webfilter.blockpage.hint: Customize what users see when access is denied. Use a logo URL, clear guidance and optional HTML/CSS for a branded page.
plugin.webfilter.blockpage.page.title: Title
plugin.webfilter.blockpage.device.title: Device delivery
plugin.webfilter.blockpage.device.hint: When saved, this page is sent on the next sync. The launcher stores the HTML locally for the controlled blocking flow; browsers that block directly through enterprise policy can still show the browser's native page.
plugin.webfilter.dns.domain.hint: MDM server address as devices see it (e.g. mdm.pmeto.local; in production, mdm.olimpia.sp.gov.br). Used in the address of the block page opened on the tablet and as the filter DNS. Must point to the MDM server in the network DNS.
plugin.webfilter.sources.hint: Manage the source credits shown for the DNS block lists.
plugin.webfilter.source.name: Name
plugin.webfilter.error.validation: Fix the highlighted items. Nothing was saved.
plugin.webfilter.error.domain: invalid domain (top-level domains and public suffixes like *.com or co.uk are not accepted)
plugin.webfilter.error.domain.protected: domain of the MDM or of the filter itself, cannot be blocked
plugin.webfilter.error.report: blocked access rejected: invalid device or URL
plugin.webfilter.error.both.lists: is in both the allowlist and the blocklist
plugin.webfilter.no.permission: You do not have permission for the Web Filter (plugin_webfilter_access).
plugin.webfilter.dns.missing: The filter DNS domain is not configured: site filtering does not reach devices. Application blocking still works. Set it in the Settings tab.
plugin.webfilter.error.package.kiosk: kiosk main app of this profile, cannot be blocked
plugin.webfilter.category.gambling.desc: Online casinos, sports betting and lotteries.
plugin.webfilter.category.social_media.d: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and other social networks.
plugin.webfilter.category.vpn_proxy.desc: VPNs, proxies and redirectors that bypass the filter.
plugin.webfilter.category.doh.desc: External DNS servers that would bypass the filter. Always blocked.
